SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Beef Farming is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Beef Farming as rumours only.
   B. Explain Beef Farming with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Beef Farming.
   D. Say Beef Farming never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.

   D. Treat School and Community as rumours only.

   A. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Eastern Africa.

   D. Explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

11. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Climatic regions in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

15. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

16. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
